entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. I'd like to talk about returning it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you please provide your full name and order number? And just to be clear, is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a preference?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, order number is VF789012. It's really a preference issue. To be honest, the interface is pretty confusing.
I see. Could you tell me a little more about what you're finding confusing?
Well, I've gone through the user manual, but navigating the menus on the device itself is just hard to use. I expected more intuitive controls. It's just not what I was looking for.
I understand completely. Sometimes a new device just doesn't click. Let me just pull up your order and our return policy. One moment.

Thanks. And listen, if a full refund isn't possible, I'd be open to discussing a partial credit or maybe a discount code for a different product. I'm a fan of your other gear, this one just missed the mark for me.
I appreciate that, Sam. Okay, I have your order here. Let me check the policy... yes, it looks like our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. When did you receive the VeloBand?
I got it about twelve days ago.

Twelve days ago is no problem at all. You are well within the 90-day window. I can go ahead and process that return for a full refund. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you right now.
Oh, wow. That's fantastic. I really appreciate you making that so simple. Thank you so much, Diana.

You're very welcome, Sam. You should see that email in the next few minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
